description: EZFlow Pro connects your contracting business to ChatGPT. Ask about your customers, jobs, schedule, and money — outstanding invoices, overdue balances, win rates — and create estimates and invoices as drafts. Every document created in chat stays a draft until you review and send it from EZFlow Pro, so nothing reaches a customer without your sign-off. New here? Try the built-in demo workspace — no account needed.

defaultPrompt: Which invoices are overdue and how much is outstanding?
